cim: A cyberattack using artificial intelligence targeted the EU in October, official says
cim_eredeti: A cyberattack using artificial intelligence targeted the EU in October, official says
szoveg_eredeti: A cyberattack using software powered by artificial intelligence targeted the European Union in October, an official in Brussels said on Thursday, with some of the bloc’s digital tools still remaining offline.
